theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose Light, Dark, or System. Changes apply right away and are saved in this browser.

motion.title: Motion and Animation
motion.description: Choose how much animation the app uses. Changes apply right away and are saved in this browser.
motion.followsReduced: Your device asks for reduced motion, so None is used until you choose a level.
motion.followsDefault: No level saved yet; Smooth is used.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.description: Only opening and closing of dialogs, side panels, and menus.

smooth.label: Smooth
smooth.description: Adds transitions on hover and when switching tabs.

lively.label: Lively
lively.description: Adds KPI numbers that count up and charts that animate on load.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for screens, PDFs, and exports on your account. Saved to your account, so it follows you to other devices.
language.saveError: Language could not be saved. Try again.

defaultLanguage.label: Default language
defaultLanguage.hint: Used by people who have not picked their own language in Settings > Appearance.
